description: This file contains utility functions for parsing and manipulating shell command strings, including handling quotes, options, arguments, and command preambles like 'set', 'export', 'unset', and directory changes.

methods.name: stripOuterQuotes
methods.description: Removes outer quotes from a string if present, handling both single and double quotes.

methods.name: splitShellWords
methods.description: Splits a shell command string into individual words, respecting quotes and escape characters, with a maximum word count.

methods.name: binaryName
methods.description: Extracts the binary name from a token, cleaning quotes and path segments, converting to lowercase.

methods.name: optionValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified option from an array of command words.

methods.name: positionalArgs
methods.description: Returns positional arguments from a command word array, considering options that take values.

methods.name: firstPositional
methods.description: Gets the first positional argument from a command word array.

methods.name: trimLeadingEnv
methods.description: Removes 'env' command prefix and environment variable assignments from the start of command words.

methods.name: unwrapShellWrapper
methods.description: Extracts the inner command from common shell wrapper commands like 'bash -c'.

methods.name: scanTopLevelChars
methods.description: Iterates over top-level characters in a command string, respecting quotes and escape sequences.

methods.name: splitTopLevelStages
methods.description: Splits a command string into stages separated by ';', '&&', or '||' at the top level.

methods.name: splitTopLevelPipes
methods.description: Splits a command string into parts separated by '|' at the top level, ignoring '||'.

methods.name: parseChdirTarget
methods.description: Parses a command head to extract the target directory for 'cd' or 'pushd' commands.

methods.name: isChdirCommand
methods.description: Checks if a command head is a 'cd', 'pushd', or 'popd' command.

methods.name: isPopdCommand
methods.description: Checks if a command head is a 'popd' command.

methods.name: stripShellPreamble
methods.description: Removes preamble commands like 'set', 'export', 'unset', and directory changes from the start of a command string, returning the cleaned command and directory path.
